messages:
alex: FYI onboarding edge sample broke after the recent exports map change in @redwood/sdk. Wrangler build error: "The requested module '/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/esm/index.js' does not provide an export named 'default'".

maria: oh no. which version did we publish? any package.json snippet?

alex: published 2.0.1. package.json exports section (copied):\n```json\n{\n  "main": "./dist/cjs/index.js",\n  "module": "./dist/esm/index.js",\n  "exports": {\n    ".": {\n      "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",\n      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"\n    },\n    "./package.json": "./package.json"\n  },\n  "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"\n}\n```

sam: that pattern is common, but some bundlers used in edge targets (wrangler/webpack in worker mode) strictly use the exports map and may not resolve an implicit default export. Also TS path mapping and .d.ts discovery can be broken if types aren't surfaced via exports.

jon: CI caught a TS error: "TS2307: Cannot find module '@redwood/sdk' or its corresponding type declarations." Repro in templates/edge-worker: checkout + yarn + wrangler build.

alex: local node import (node 20) works, but worker bundle fails. quick hack: `import * as SDK from '@redwood/sdk'` works locally but not in the bundle. So resolver differences.

maria: short-term patch idea: expand exports to include fallback subpaths and expose types from the exports map. e.g.:\n```json\n"exports": {\n  ".": {\n    "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",\n    "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js",\n    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"\n  },\n  "./*": "./dist/*"\n}\n```
This helps bundlers that rewrite imports to explicit subpaths like `@redwood/sdk/dist/esm/index.js`.

sam: also adding a tiny smoke test in CI that runs the edge template `wrangler build` on canary publishes would catch this earlier. I'll add a job in the release pipeline.

pkg-bot: published @redwood/sdk@2.0.1-fix-exports :package:

jon: opened PR to revert the problematic packaging change and add tests: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/429 — includes a canary publish and a wrapping smoke test (wrangler build + ts compile).

alex: follow-ups: 1) add edge-template smoke job in release, 2) doc note in changelog about exports/edge compatibility, 3) create a quick devex checklist for exports changes (who to ping, which templates to run).

maria: will draft the checklist and update the changelog. sam, can you wire the release job?

sam: yes, will wire it and run against the canary later today.

alex: thanks team. painful onboarding hit but we should be able to prevent recurrence. :wave:
